parts.zh: 英国政府呼吁更多男性考虑从事护理职业
W: 嗯，我已经工作几年了
M: 哇，那你肯定感觉很棒
W: 是啊,我以前从来没挣过这么多钱
M: 我买了一套新西装上班穿
W: 我有足够的职业装了
M: 如果我是你，我会加入健身房
W: 嗯。你说得对。谢谢你的建议

items.stem: What problem is Britain facing?

choices.text: The number of nurses has dropped to a record low.
choices.zh: 护士数量已降至历史最低水平。

choices.text: There is a growing shortage of medical personnel.
choices.zh: 医疗人员日益短缺。

choices.text: There is discrimination against male nurses.
choices.zh: 存在针对男护士的歧视。

choices.text: The number of male nurses has gone down.
choices.zh: 男护士数量有所下降。

items.stem: What is the cause of the problem according to the UK Health Secretary?

choices.text: Cultural bias.
choices.zh: 文化偏见。

choices.text: Inadequate pay.
choices.zh: 薪酬不足。

choices.text: Educational system.
choices.zh: 教育体系。

choices.text: Working conditions.
choices.zh: 工作条件。

items.stem: What does the news report say about the Libyan man?

choices.text: He fell out of a lifeboat.
choices.zh: 他从救生艇上掉了下来。

choices.text: He lost his way on a beach.
choices.zh: 他在海滩上迷路了。

choices.text: He was almost drowned.
choices.zh: 他差点溺水。

choices.text: He enjoyed swimming in the sea.
choices.zh: 他喜欢在海里游泳。

items.stem: What did Keith Porter say at an interview?

choices.text: The beach is a popular tourist resort.
choices.zh: 这个海滩是热门的旅游胜地。

choices.text: The emergency services are efficient.
choices.zh: 应急服务很高效。

choices.text: The beach is a good place to watch the tide.
choices.zh: 这个海滩是观赏潮汐的好地方。

choices.text: The lifeboats patrol the area round the clock.
choices.zh: 救生艇全天候在该区域巡逻。

items.stem: What does the news report say about the raccoon, a small cat-like animal?

choices.text: It became an online star.
choices.zh: 它成为了网络明星。

choices.text: It broke into an office room.
choices.zh: 它闯入了一间办公室。

choices.text: It escaped from a local zoo.
choices.zh: 它从当地动物园逃跑了。

choices.text: It climbed 25 storeys at one go.
choices.zh: 它一口气爬了25层楼。

items.stem: What will the wildlife management company do with the captured raccoon?

choices.text: Send it back to the zoo.
choices.zh: 把它送回动物园。

choices.text: Release it into the wild.
choices.zh: 把它放归野外。

choices.text: Return it to its owner.
choices.zh: 把它还给主人。

choices.text: Give it a physical checkup.
choices.zh: 给它做身体检查。

items.stem: What did one online post say?

choices.text: A raccoon can perform acts no human can.
choices.zh: 浣熊能做人类做不到的事。

choices.text: A raccoon can climb much higher than a cat.
choices.zh: 浣熊能爬得比猫高得多。

choices.text: The raccoon became as famous as some politicians.
choices.zh: 这只浣熊变得和一些政客一样有名。

choices.text: The raccoon did something no politician could.
choices.zh: 这只浣熊做了政客做不到的事。

items.stem: Why did the woman feel excited?

choices.text: She got a well-paying job in a bank.
choices.zh: 她在一家银行得到了一份高薪工作。

choices.text: She received a bonus unexpectedly.
choices.zh: 她意外地收到了一笔奖金。

choices.text: She received her first monthly salary.
choices.zh: 她收到了她的第一份月薪。

choices.text: She got a pay raise for her performance.
choices.zh: 她因为工作表现获得了加薪。

items.stem: When did the man get his first full-time job?

choices.text: Several years ago.
choices.zh: 几年前。

choices.text: Two decades ago.
choices.zh: 二十年前。

choices.text: Right after graduation.
choices.zh: 刚毕业之后。

choices.text: Just last month.
choices.zh: 就在上个月。

items.stem: What did the man do when he got his first pay?

choices.text: He sent a small check to his parents.
choices.zh: 他给父母寄了一张小额支票。

choices.text: He took a few of his friends to a gym.
choices.zh: 他带几个朋友去了健身房。

choices.text: He immediately deposited it in a bank.
choices.zh: 他立即把钱存入了银行。

choices.text: He treated his parents to a nice meal.
choices.zh: 他请父母吃了一顿丰盛的饭。

items.stem: What does the woman say she is going to do?

choices.text: Buy some professional clothes.
choices.zh: 购买一些职业装。

choices.text: Budget her salary carefully.
choices.zh: 仔细规划她的薪水预算。

choices.text: Join her colleagues for gym exercise.
choices.zh: 加入同事们一起进行健身锻炼。

choices.text: Visit her former university campus.
choices.zh: 参观她以前就读的大学校园。

items.stem: Why does the man seem to be distracted?

choices.text: He has a difficult decision to make.
choices.zh: 他有一个艰难的决定要做。

choices.text: He has been overworked recently.
choices.zh: 他最近工作过度。

choices.text: He has just quarreled with his girlfriend.
choices.zh: 他刚刚和女朋友吵架了。

choices.text: He has just too many things to attend to.
choices.zh: 他有太多事情要处理。

items.stem: What does the woman say the man should do?

choices.text: Give priority to things more urgent.
choices.zh: 优先处理更紧急的事情。

choices.text: Turn to his girlfriend for assistance.
choices.zh: 向他的女朋友寻求帮助。

choices.text: Think twice before making the decision.
choices.zh: 做决定前三思而后行。

choices.text: Seek advice from his family and advisor.
choices.zh: 向他的家人和导师征求意见。

items.stem: What does the man say is part of his problem?

choices.text: His parents and advisor have different opinions.
choices.zh: 他的父母和导师有不同的意见。

choices.text: He is not particularly keen on the job offered.
choices.zh: 他对提供的工作不是特别感兴趣。

choices.text: He lacks the money for his doctoral program.
choices.zh: 他缺乏攻读博士课程的资金。

choices.text: His girlfriend does not support his decision.
choices.zh: 他的女朋友不支持他的决定。

items.stem: Why doesn't the man's girlfriend agree to get married right now?

choices.text: They need time to make preparations.
choices.zh: 他们需要时间做准备。

choices.text: They need to save enough money for it.
choices.zh: 他们需要为此存够钱。

choices.text: They haven't started their careers yet.
choices.zh: 他们还没有开始自己的职业生涯。

choices.text: They haven't won their parents' approval.
choices.zh: 他们还没有得到父母的同意。

items.stem: What kind of ability do analytical skills refer to in the passage?

choices.text: Acquiring information and professional knowledge.
choices.zh: 获取信息和专业知识。

choices.text: Using information to understand and solve problems.
choices.zh: 运用信息来理解和解决问题。

choices.text: Enriching social and intellectual lives.
choices.zh: 丰富社交和智力生活。

choices.text: Expressing ideas and opinions freely.
choices.zh: 自由表达想法和观点。

items.stem: What does the passage say is an entertaining way of enhancing one's analytical skills?

choices.text: Improving mind-reading strategies.
choices.zh: 改进读心策略。

choices.text: Reading classic scientific literature.
choices.zh: 阅读经典科学文献。

choices.text: Playing games that challenge one's mind.
choices.zh: 玩挑战思维的游戏。

choices.text: Traveling to different places in the world.
choices.zh: 到世界各地旅行。

items.stem: What else does the speaker advise people to do to improve their analytical skills?

choices.text: Give others freedom to express themselves.
choices.zh: 给予他人表达自己的自由。

choices.text: Expose themselves to different cultures.
choices.zh: 让自己接触不同的文化。

choices.text: Discard personal biases and prejudices.
choices.zh: 摒弃个人偏见和成见。

choices.text: Participate in debates or discussions.
choices.zh: 参与辩论或讨论。

items.stem: What does the passage say we don't know much about?

choices.text: The nature of relationships between dogs.
choices.zh: 狗之间关系的本质。

choices.text: The reason a great many people love dogs.
choices.zh: 很多人喜爱狗的原因。

choices.text: Why dogs can be faithful friends of humans.
choices.zh: 狗为什么能成为人类忠实的朋友。

choices.text: How dogs feel about their bonds with humans.
choices.zh: 狗如何看待它们与人类的纽带。

items.stem: What does Dr. Marc Bekoff say about dogs?

choices.text: They have an unusual sense of responsibility.
choices.zh: 它们有一种不同寻常的责任感。

choices.text: They can respond to humans' questions.
choices.zh: 它们能回应人类的提问。

choices.text: They can fall in love just like humans.
choices.zh: 它们能像人类一样坠入爱河。

choices.text: They behave like other animals in many ways.
choices.zh: 它们在许多方面表现得像其他动物。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about most dogs?

choices.text: They have their own joys and sorrows.
choices.zh: 它们有自己的喜怒哀乐。

choices.text: They experience true romantic love.
choices.zh: 它们体验真正的浪漫爱情。

choices.text: They help humans in various ways.
choices.zh: 它们以各种方式帮助人类。

choices.text: They stay with one partner for life.
choices.zh: 它们终生只与一个伴侣在一起。

items.stem: What did the boy Jude Sparks think he had discovered?

choices.text: A cow bone.
choices.zh: 一块牛骨。

choices.text: A rare animal.
choices.zh: 一种稀有动物。

choices.text: A historical site.
choices.zh: 一处历史遗址。

choices.text: A precious stone.
choices.zh: 一块珍贵的石头。

items.stem: What are the researchers at New Mexico State University doing with the boy's discovery?

choices.text: Measuring it.
choices.zh: 测量它。

choices.text: Preserving it.
choices.zh: 保存它。

choices.text: Dating it.
choices.zh: 测定它的年代。

choices.text: Identifying it.
choices.zh: 鉴定它。

items.stem: What did Professor Peter Houde say when interviewed by ABC News?

choices.text: The site should have been protected.
choices.zh: 这个地点本应受到保护。

choices.text: The boy's family had acted correctly.
choices.zh: 这个男孩的家人做法正确。

choices.text: The boy should have called an expert.
choices.zh: 这个男孩本应联系专家。

choices.text: The channel needs to interview the boy.
choices.zh: 该频道需要采访这个男孩。

items.stem: What do the researchers plan to do?

choices.text: Search for similar fossils elsewhere.
choices.zh: 在其他地方寻找类似的化石。

choices.text: Ask the university to reward Jude.
choices.zh: 请求该大学奖励Jude。

choices.text: Conduct a more detailed search.
choices.zh: 进行更详细的搜寻。

choices.text: Seek additional funds for the search.
choices.zh: 为搜寻工作寻求额外资金。
